name: Bathysuchus
sum: Bathysuchus is a teleosaurid thalattosuchian from Late Jurassic deep-water marine deposits of England and France.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: One occurrence in the Kimmeridge Clay.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Foffa et al. 2019
